# Time budgets for go test, read by internal/testtime.
#   leaf SECONDS                  a test that has no subtests
#   package PATH|default SECONDS  wall time of one package; PATH@JOB sets it for one job
#   test PATH NAME SECONDS        tests of PATH whose name starts with NAME
# A test with subtests is not checked, because a parallel parent reports the time of the whole package.
# A change that makes a test or package slower raises its number in the same diff and states why.

leaf 10
package default 10

# Each contract test of cmd/ward starts a motte server and a git http-backend remote, and runs ward and the git
# binary against them. Process spawn dominates, so the package needs more than the default.
package cmd/ward 30
